description: The pair of maximal-terminator-bounded with begins from the capture, which sees the rest of the input. There y → A B is longer, so leaving out [T] after y → A is forbidden. Through y → A B, r finds no B after it. So begins of r is false (engine §4).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%elidable maximal T
%rule text $x(A) B
%conditions begins(from($x), r)
%rule r y [T] B
%rule y A | A B
